jobs.detail: LEVER SEATED REVERSE FLY with PARALLEL NEUTRAL GRIP. REAR three-quarter camera shows posterior shoulders and both hands. Adult sits facing into reverse-fly station with CHEST against front vertical chest pad, feet flat floor, torso upright/stationary. Both hands grip VERTICAL handles, palms face each other, thumbs wrap. LEFT start arms reach forward around chest pad at shoulder level, elbows slightly bent. RIGHT spread SAME arms OUTWARD/BACK to sides at shoulder height, maintaining SAME slight elbow bend, shoulder blades retract; not a row, no elbow flexion, no torso lean. Stop upper arms approximately in plane of torso, no excessive shoulder extension. Simple machine has two SAME LENGTH rigid moving arms rotating around FIXED vertical axes above/front shoulders; handles always visibly connected. SAME frame/pivots/pad/seat/stack/base and camera in both panels. Both posterior DELTOID shoulder caps exposed RED only, traps/back/triceps/forearms grayscale, entire black shirt BLACK no red back. Entire wide-open arms/handles and all machine fit within each panel.
jobs.prompt: Correct ONLY LEFT START PANEL of this original project reverse fly so it is a shoulder reverse-fly, not a bent-elbow row. BOTH arms should reach FORWARD around front of chest pad with elbows NEARLY STRAIGHT, just15degrees flexion, same elbow bend as RIGHT endpoint. In left panel extend upper arms/forearms together toward the front of the machine, hands farther forward away from chest, adjust connected vertical grips and swinging lever angle to meet hands. Keep palms facing each other, thumbs wrapped. Chest stays against pad; torso, legs, seat, fixed frame/pivots unchanged. RIGHT panel stays unchanged, arms spread outward at shoulder height. Red on posterior deltoids only, rest grayscale, detailed exposed fibers. Opaque BLACK shirt and shorts fully wrap front/sides/back/seat/crotch. White background, entire machine/body within each panel, no text. Preserve original male/female identity of supplied image.

jobs.detail: LEVER STANDING CALF RAISE, SIDE three-quarter camera shows both heels and toes clearly. Stand straight in shoulder-pad calf machine, feet shoulder-width on edge of raised fixed FOOT BLOCK, balls of BOTH feet supported on block, heels extend beyond rear edge. Shoulders beneath two padded supports attached to lever resistance frame; hands grasp shoulder-height handles securely. Spine neutral, knees nearly straight but softly unlocked and UNCHANGED across phases. LEFT heels lowered below block top in controlled ankle dorsiflexion, balls/toes remain on block. RIGHT push through same balls of feet and plantarflex BOTH ankles to raise BOTH heels clearly above block top; WHOLE body/shoulder carriage rises together, same upright posture, no knee bending or toe reposition. Body proportion/leg lengths fixed, ONLY ankle angle changes. Shoulder pads remain contacting shoulders and connected lever rotates around same FIXED pivot; same weight-stack machine frame/base/footblock in both panels. Red highlights ONLY exposed posterior CALVES on both lower legs, other anatomy grayscale, whole shirt/shorts BLACK opaque. Both shoes and entire machine including overhead frame and footblock within panels with white margins.

jobs.detail: KNEE-TO-CHEST FLOOR PUSH-UP, THREE phases. RIGHT after next rep press up and draw LEFT knee FORWARD under torso toward chest, LEFT foot lifted, RIGHT leg STRAIGHT behind toes mat. Clearly swap the bent-leg hip origin: middle FAR/right thigh bends under body while NEAR/left leg extends back; final NEAR/left thigh bends under body while FAR/right extends back. Pelvis level, only one knee bends in each high plank, exactly2legs/2arms. Whole figure/hands/shoes fit each panel white margins. No text.

Bend both elbows to lower the chest, keeping each hand on its support; switch ball hand after the set

jobs.detail: ONE HAND ON STABILITY BALL PUSH-UP, TWO phases, full body FRONT SIDE three-quarter camera head LEFT feet RIGHT. One round gray FULL SPHERE stability ball on floor at FAR/RIGHT shoulder side, no platform/bench. RIGHT hand palm on TOP/upper side of ball; LEFT hand palm flat on FLOOR at near side beneath LEFT shoulder. Both hands clearly visible in unequal height positions. Both feet wider than hips toes FLOOR behind, knees straight and core braced straight shoulder-hip-heel line. LEFT upper position floor-side LEFT elbow extended, ball-side RIGHT elbow flexed as needed for unequal hand height; palm contacts ball securely, no floating hand. RIGHT lower chest toward floor by flexing BOTH elbows while keeping torso/hips level, no rotation or sag, right palm remains ball and left floor at EXACT same locations, ball shape/size unchanged. Hands do NOT switch sides between phases; opposite-hand set performed later outside image. EXACTLY TWO arms/legs, whole sphere/person/hands/shoes in frame. Primary CHEST only smooth soft diffuse BLURRED red tint on opaque BLACK chest shirt; no anatomical fibers/radial lines/pectoral divisions in clothing. Fine grayscale exposed limb anatomy. Full opaque shirt/shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch. No text.

poses.caption: Lie supine with knees bent, feet flat and arms at sides.
Tilt the pelvis and slowly peel the lower spine off the mat.
Lift into a bridge, pause, then roll the spine down slowly.

jobs.detail: ROLLING BRIDGE, THREE phases of ONE slow repetition. Full-body SIDE VIEW, HEAD LEFT FEET RIGHT in every panel. Lie supine face UP on plain thin gray floor mat. Back of skull rests DIRECTLY ON MAT in ALL phases, eyes ceiling, neck relaxed neutral, no head lifting or neck bridging. Arms straight at sides palms down, knees bent and both feet flat hip width, heels under knees at top, feet NEVER move. LEFT START: pelvis and full back on mat, knees bent. CENTER PARTIAL ROLL: posterior pelvic tilt, tailbone/pelvis and lower lumbar lift just slightly while upper and middle back and head stay grounded. RIGHT TOP: pelvis rises to gentle bridge with shoulders/hips/knees aligned, upper shoulder blades and skull stay grounded; no excessive lumbar arch. Both arms stay mat at sides, both shoes planted in every phase. Display clearly progressive low/mid/high pelvic elevation. No equipment except thin mat. Fine grayscale exposed arm/calf anatomy, red only soft blurred abdominal fabric tint, opaque shirt continuous to waistband no abdomen exposed.

Lower slowly, then sit up toward the opposite knee with the left elbow; alternate sides.

jobs.detail: ALTERNATING DIAGONAL SIDE SIT-UP, THREE equal SQUARE panels wide landscape one row. Same high front three-quarter camera, head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT, front torso/legs visible. CENTER: sit torso UP and ROTATE shoulder girdle toward MODEL LEFT so RIGHT elbow approaches LEFT knee, elbow does not need touch, pelvis remains grounded, feet stay flat, torso rises about45degrees. RIGHT: after returning down and rising again, sit UP and rotate shoulder girdle MODEL RIGHT so LEFT elbow approaches RIGHT knee; clearly opposite crossing elbow/knee pair, both feet fixed on floor, no bicycle. Crunch the top elbow toward the hip while keeping legs grounded, then return to the stretch and switch sides.

jobs.detail: SIDE STRETCH CRUNCH, TWO equal SQUARE cells SIDE BY SIDE wide landscape, same FRONT-side three-quarter view head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT. Lie on LEFT SIDE on gray mat, both legs extended straight stacked together and resting floor BOTH phases, pelvis remains on lateral hip grounded, no leg lift. LEFT bottom arm STRAIGHT extends OVERHEAD along mat to image LEFT past head, left elbow straight palm relaxed down, this arm remains on mat unchanged in both phases. RIGHT top hand LIGHTLY behind head near right ear elbow open, no neck pulling. LEFT STRETCH: torso lengthened lying low, head aligned spine near bottom extended arm, right elbow away from hip. RIGHT CRUNCH: laterally bend ribs toward right hip to lift shoulders/head moderately off mat, right top elbow moves toward right hip, pelvis and both straight legs stay on floor, left bottom arm STILL extended overhead on mat, not propping on forearm. No rolling onto back/seated position, no knee bend.
